# AI Council Orchestrator

> AI Council is a free, open-source, cross-platform CLI (macOS, Linux, Windows) that runs multiple AI coding agent CLIs — Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Aider, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Goose, Amp, Factory Droid — in parallel on the same task, collects their independent plans, runs an anonymized critique pass with a Devil's Advocate, and saves the whole session to disk as auditable artifacts. It requires no API keys: it orchestrates vendor CLIs the user has already installed and authenticated.

Key facts:
- Install: `brew install alijamal14/tap/council` (macOS/Linux), `scoop install council` from bucket `alijamal14/scoop-bucket` (Windows), `go install github.com/alijamal14/council@latest`, or install scripts in `scripts/`.
- Verify setup: `council doctor` (agent inventory + auth state). Machine-readable: `council doctor --json` returns totals {supported, installed, authenticated, login_required} plus per-agent auth, login hints, and vendor limits URLs. `--ping` verifies auth with one tiny prompt per agent.
- Install missing agent CLIs: `council setup` (list) or `council setup --apply` (runs npm/pip installers).
- RAG hook: set `COUNCIL_CONTEXT_CMD="<retrieval command>"` and Council injects its stdout into every agent's context.
- Run: `council "your task"` — needs at least one supported AI CLI installed and signed in.
- Continue a session: `council --continue council_runs/run_<timestamp> "feedback"`.
- Results: written to `council_runs/run_<timestamp>/` as `plan.<agent>.txt`, `critique.<agent>.txt`, `label_map.json`, `brief.txt`, and `audit.jsonl`.
- Exit codes: 0 = all agents succeeded, 1 = partial success, 2 = failure.
- If you are an AI agent invoking Council: run it in the background (sessions take minutes and shell tools buffer output), then poll the newest `council_runs/run_*/` directory for result files.
- License: Apache 2.0. No telemetry, no hosted service, no credential storage.
